title: Implement Project Workflow (configuration)
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.1 (US-0A-15). See user story map US-0A-15 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.1-workflow-config.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Load a valid workflow configuration
Given ".wingfoil/workflows.yaml" declares a workflow "release-cycle" with kind "main"
When the workflow configuration is loaded
Then "release-cycle" is registered as an independently startable main workflow

title: Implement wingfoil workflow start
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.2 (US-0A-16). See user story map US-0A-16 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.2-workflow-start.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Start a main workflow
When I run "wingfoil workflow start --name release-cycle"
Then "release-cycle" becomes the active workflow context
And its first step is initialized
And the command exits with code 0

title: Implement wingfoil workflow end
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.3 (US-0A-17). See user story map US-0A-17 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.3-workflow-end.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: End the active workflow
When I run "wingfoil workflow end"
Then "release-cycle" is closed
And the active workflow context is cleared
And the command exits with code 0

title: Implement wingfoil workflow next
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.4 (US-1-01). See user story map US-1-01 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.4-workflow-next.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Show the next actionable step
When I run "wingfoil workflow next"
Then the output shows the next step name, its target element, the role, and role directives
And the response is produced in under 1 second

title: Implement wingfoil workflow status
description: As Sam, deliver feature P4.5 (US-2-01). See user story map US-2-01 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.5-workflow-status.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Show status of all open workflows
When I run "wingfoil workflow status"
Then both open workflows are listed
And the active workflow is highlighted
And the 1 pending approval is shown

title: Implement wingfoil workflow list
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.6 (US-0A-18). See user story map US-0A-18 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.6-workflow-list.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: List only currently executable workflows
When I run "wingfoil workflow list"
Then "release-cycle" and "report-bug" are listed as startable
And "dev-loop" is NOT listed because it is not the next step

title: Implement wingfoil workflow show
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.7 (US-0A-19). See user story map US-0A-19 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.7-workflow-show.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Show a workflow's structure
When I run "wingfoil workflow show --name release-cycle"
Then the output lists each phase, its steps, the role directives, and the Memory elements

title: Implement wingfoil workflow create
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.8 (US-6-02). See user story map US-6-02 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.8-workflow-create.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Create a custom workflow via flags
When I run "wingfoil workflow create --name arch-review --kind main"
Then a workflow file "arch-review" is created under ".wingfoil/workflows/custom/"
And it is referenced by the main ".wingfoil/workflows.yaml"
And the command exits with code 0

title: Implement wingfoil workflow remove
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.9 (US-6-11). See user story map US-6-11 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.9-workflow-remove.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Remove an unreferenced custom workflow
Given "arch-review" is not included by any other workflow
When I run "wingfoil workflow remove arch-review"
Then the workflow file is deleted and the removal is committed
And the command exits with code 0

title: Implement Deliverables (Memory + State)
description: As Jordan, deliver feature P4.11 (US-4-08). See user story map US-4-08 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.11-deliverables.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Create a deliverable with initial state
When I run "wingfoil memory add --type task --title 'implement billing'"
Then a deliverable file is created with frontmatter "status: draft"
And the command exits with code 0

title: Implement Workflow State Deduction
description: As All, deliver feature P4.13 (US-1-02). See user story map US-1-02 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.13-state-deduction.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Deduce task progress from frontmatter
Given a "task" file has frontmatter "status: in-progress"
When workflow state is computed
Then that task is reported as being implemented
And the result is derived only from the Memory file, not a separate index

title: Implement Approval Routing (role-based)
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.14 (US-4-07). See user story map US-4-07 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.14-approval-routing.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Route a pending approval to the role holder
When a deliverable reaches the approval step
Then the approval request is routed to "Morgan"
And "Morgan" is recorded as the responsible approver

title: Implement Fallback on Rejection
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.15 (US-4-12). See user story map US-4-12 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.15-fallback-on-rejection.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Reject jumps to the fallback step and sets state
When "task-101" is rejected at the review step
Then the workflow position moves to step "red"
And "task-101" frontmatter becomes "status: in-progress"

title: Implement Workflow include() Composition
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.16 (US-6-04). See user story map US-6-04 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.16-include-composition.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Iterate the included sub once per matching element
Given 3 tasks have "status: backlog" and 1 task has "status: done"
When the phase executes
Then the sub "dev-loop" runs exactly 3 times, once per backlog task

title: Implement Reference Workflow Templates
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.18 (US-0A-10). See user story map US-0A-10 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.18-reference-workflow-templates.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario Outline: Select a reference methodology template
When I select the "<methodology>" reference template during init
Then a workflow configuration matching "<methodology>" is generated
And the command exits with code 0

title: Implement Template Expansion
description: As Alex, deliver feature P4.19 (US-0A-11). See user story map US-0A-11 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.19-template-expansion.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Expansion generates the full configuration set
When the template is expanded
Then workflow phases, role directives, and Memory sections are generated together
And the generated artifacts are committed to git

title: Implement Template Customization
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P4.20 (US-0A-12). See user story map US-0A-12 and BDD p4-workflow/P4.20-template-customization.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Override a template default
When I override the approval role to "lead-architect"
Then the resulting workflow uses "lead-architect" as the approval role
And the override is persisted in the custom workflow file

title: Implement wingfoil agent execute [--next]
description: As Alex, deliver feature P5.3.1 (US-1-03). See user story map US-1-03 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.3.1-agent-execute.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Launch agent resolving role and element from the step
When I run "wingfoil agent execute --next"
Then the agent starts with role "developer" and element "task:101"
And DNA, Memory, and directives for that role are pre-loaded
And the agent is ready within 30 seconds of launch

title: Implement Agent Role Selection per Step
description: As All, deliver feature P5.3.2 (US-2-07). See user story map US-2-07 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.3.2-agent-role-selection.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Role is selected from the current step
When an agent executes the "Code Review" step
Then the agent runs under role "reviewer"
And reviewer directives are loaded

title: Implement Relevance Filtering
description: As Agents, deliver feature P5.3.3 (US-1-10). See user story map US-1-10 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.3.3-relevance-filtering.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Load only relevant documents
When the agent assembles task context
Then only the 5 relevant documents are loaded
And the 95 unrelated documents are excluded

title: Implement Agent Role Definition
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P5.4.1 (US-0A-13). See user story map US-0A-13 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.4.1-agent-role-definition.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Define a built-in agent role
When I define the role "reviewer" in DNA
Then "reviewer" is available for directive assignment and step routing

title: Implement Agent Role -> Directives Binding
description: As Morgan, deliver feature P5.4.2 (US-3-07). See user story map US-3-07 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.4.2-role-directives-binding.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Bound directives auto-load on agent execution
When an agent executes under role "developer"
Then the "testing" directive is loaded into the agent context automatically

title: Implement Agent Context Pre-Loading
description: As Agents, deliver feature P5.4.3 (US-1-04). See user story map US-1-04 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.4.3-context-preloading.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Pre-load context within the time budget
When the agent initializes
Then DNA, relevant Memory, and role directives are fetched automatically
And pre-loading completes in under 30 seconds

title: Implement Agent Execution Context
description: As Agents, deliver feature P5.4.4 (US-1-05). See user story map US-1-05 and BDD p5-interaction/P5.4.4-execution-context.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Receive a structured execution context
When the task starts
Then the agent receives a context object containing distinct DNA, Memory, and Directives sections
And each section is individually addressable

title: Implement Human Needed Notifications
description: As Morgan, deliver feature X1.1 (US-2-02). See user story map US-2-02 and BDD x1-notification/X1.1-human-needed-notifications.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Notify on a pending approval
Given a deliverable transitions to "status: pending" requiring approval
When the notification system processes the event
Then a "human needed" notification is emitted naming the required action and the document id

title: Implement Notification Routing
description: As Morgan, deliver feature X1.2 (US-2-03). See user story map US-2-03 and BDD x1-notification/X1.2-notification-routing.feature.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Route an approval notification to the role holder
Given an approval requires the "approver" role
When the notification is routed
Then it is delivered to "Morgan"
And it is NOT delivered to "Casey"

title: REQ-INT-09: Notification delivery channel & failure contract
description: Implement the Integrations constraint REQ-INT-09. See SARD fit criterion in docs/02_requirements/03_sard/.
acceptance_criteria: Fit Criterion: 100% of 'human-needed' events (approval/decision required) produce a notification record; on delivery failure the system logs "notification delivery failed for event <id>" and exits non-zero — asserted in test.

title: REQ-SEC-11: Notification routing authority by role/decision-type
description: Implement the Security constraint REQ-SEC-11. See SARD fit criterion in docs/02_requirements/03_sard/.
acceptance_criteria: Fit Criterion: A notification is routed to exactly the roles/persons configured for its decision-type in dna.yaml; 0 notifications routed to unconfigured roles — asserted over a routing fixture.
